## v1.37.0

Live sessions use the short-lived TURN credentials the server sends for each session. Upgrade the pin to stay on the supported path. No code change is needed. One behavior change: a media channel that keeps failing now ends the session (see Behavior change).

### Changed

- Sessions use the per-session TURN credentials the server sends, listed before the existing TURN entry. Sessions still connect when the server sends none. (#424)
- When both entries use the same relay host, each UDP address goes to one entry only, so media stays on UDP while the relay accepts just one of them. (#424)
- Credentials close to expiry are renewed on a fresh socket before the SDK opens new relay connections, for example on `resume()` after a long pause. (#424)
- `turnCredentials` for another TURN host are still used alone, as before. (#424)
- If the browser or the relay refuses the server's TURN entry, the session uses the configured entry. The logger gets one `[turn]` warning. (#424)
- The logger gets one `[turn]` warning when a session has no TURN server at all. (#424)
- `KalturaScriptedVideoSession` accepts `turn` as a host, `host:port`, full `turn:`/`turns:` URLs or a list, with `credential`, `password` or neither (the default credentials apply). A `turn:` URL with no port gets the standard ports and transports, as before. (#424)
- The socket connect query carries `sdk` with the SDK version. (#424)

### Behavior change

- A channel that needs a third recovery with no ICE up since the first one ends the session with `reconnect_failed`. Before, the mic uplink could keep recovering with no end. (#424)

### Docs and skill

- `avatarSessions.initClient()` docs: `turn` holds short-lived credentials for that session. (#424)
- TURN sources and the server `turn` field: [audio-channels.md §5](docs/wire-protocol/audio-channels.md#5-asr-uplink-pc1-microphone--server). (#424)
